[[Category:Tranquility Cemetery, Tranquility, Ohio]]
== Biography ==
Mary was born in 1811. She passed away in 1900. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Father identification ===

[[Glasgow-653|Joseph Glasgow]] is confidently inferred to be this person’s father, assessed 94%. The memoir’s Polly, wife of John Williams, matches Mary Finley Glasgow and John Williams-103918 in the same family. Polly is a customary Mary variant. The spouse and sibling network add a specific family identification to the formerly sparse memorial account; the name variant and mixed sibling list leave some uncertainty. <ref name="Miami1919">John C. Hover et al., eds., ''Memoirs of the Miami Valley'' (Robert O. Law Company, 1919–1920), “S. S. Glasgow,” printed pp. 257–258; [https://digital.cincinnatilibrary.org/iiif/2/p16998coll15:18001/full/full/0/default.jpg original p. 257] and [https://digital.cincinnatilibrary.org/iiif/2/p16998coll15:18002/full/full/0/default.jpg original p. 258], Cincinnati & Hamilton County Public Library Digital Library; images inspected 22 October 2026. Published family biography, not a civil or parish register.</ref>

The memoir never names Joseph: its sibling group is linked to [[Glasgow-1625|Robert Anderson]], whose 1880 county biography names Joseph and Nancy. The memoir’s ancestral migration story is inconsistent with Joseph’s Virginia birth, and Eliza/Breckenridge appears to be a Campbell half-sister. These problems qualify the whole-pair inference; no mother or vital fact is changed. The 1880 statement is used from its published citation and held biographical account, not a newly inspected image.


=== Earlier father assessment, 22 October 2026 — superseded ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-653]] is assessed at 76% (probable). Faris’s 1990 Glasgow Family genealogy supplies the Joseph/Nancy family framework; Mary’s 1811 birth and 1900 memorial fit, but her own held biography does not name parents. Joseph’s reported 1820 Ohio death is compatible with the birth, but no original relationship passage is transcribed.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Read Faris’s Joseph child list and trace this child’s original marriage/probate evidence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/16346695/mary-finley-williams https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/16346695/mary-finley-williams]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
